decision: No defensible novelty claim yet. Retire generic enforcement-latency and churn-monitor claims; investigate measurement validity only as a bounded candidate.

sources.finding: Already measures traffic reachability after pod creation under churn and after a deny-to-allow policy transition. This defeats generic traffic-based enforcement measurement novelty.

RecordFirstSuccessfulRequest retries curl until success or a signal checked between attempts. It passes a connection timeout, with no transfer deadline. Neither this loop nor runCommand implements the documented one-second pacing. No upstream program execution was performed.

Targets come from a limited pod list. A successful probe triggers retrieval/caching of policy creation time and histogram observation. Retrieval failure returns without observation. Pending probes do not produce latency observations. This is a completion-time metric, not proof of universal isolation.

sources.review: PR description and GitHub API merge metadata, not an independent reproduction
sources.finding: Prior correction deduplicates trigger timestamps and suppresses invalid observations. Stale-timestamp metric inflation is established prior work, not our discovery.

sources.title: How segmented is my network?
sources.review: Sections III and IV inspected; remaining operational limitations require review
sources.finding: Estimates policy permissiveness using sampled connectivity outcomes and a fixed protocol suite. Its scope excludes enforcement correctness. Any proposed sampling or uncertainty contribution must distinguish this work and standard statistical methods.

sources.title: Zero-trust node security for KubeEdge: A policy-as-service architecture and reliability evaluation
sources.review: Publisher search excerpts only; full-page access returned 403
sources.finding: Potential close overlap on revocation completion and non-completing runs. Cannot claim a gap until methods and limitations are inspected.

calibration.finding: All sockets were accepted. Ten responses completed. Two withheld bodies exceeded the one-second connection timeout and required the external two-second watchdog. Delayed bodies delayed the measured completion.
calibration.interpretation: Expected curl semantics confirmed on local Windows. Not an upstream Kubernetes reproduction, observed CNI defect, or novel result.

candidate.question: Under controlled churn and application delay, do existing enforcement measurement methods produce materially different deadline decisions from independent packet and application evidence, after accounting for incomplete targets?
candidate.potential_contribution: A replicated empirical measurement-validity result and correction with documented applicability, if existing tools and literature do not already establish it.
baselines: Fixed-deadline completion counts with explicit pending targets
reject_if: Only known curl timeout behavior is demonstrated
Completion coverage and standard censoring treatment eliminate all apparent contribution
Prior work already covers the same confounds and correction
Differences do not alter a prespecified operational conclusion
The comparison changes intended metric definitions rather than showing a validity problem
next_required: Complete full-method review of KubeEdge study and related measurement work
Trace target membership and timing definitions for all selected baselines
Set effect thresholds and fault controls before any cluster experiment
candidate.hpc: Not warranted. No cluster or large experiment authorized by this gate.

additional_review.review: Creation callback and result aggregation inspected, client/proxy internals still pending
additional_review.finding: Records creation timestamps and aggregates returned connection times by policy. Reuses a connection observation for matching policies. Negative latency is warned about and appended. These are source observations, not demonstrated deployment errors. End-to-end completeness cannot be inferred without inspecting the client/proxy.

Copies current manager endpoint membership under a read lock, then reads models through workers. This supports current-inventory semantics; it does not establish a defect or a simultaneous state snapshot.
Explicitly acknowledges static measurement, symmetric edges and sampling limitations. Merely adding dynamics or asymmetric edges is not sufficient novelty.
